author: Home
title: Indra Nooyi Leaves PepsiCo's New CEO At Least 3 Big Challenges
text:
PepsiCo ( PEP ) CEO Ramon Laguarta will have to quickly hit the ground running.
The incoming replacement for CEO Indra Nooyi, who said Monday she will step aside on Oct. 3 , must solve a host of challenges early on. Laguarta will have to decide whether to re-franchise the company's bottling operations and streamline the workforce. He must also find a way to ignite sales of diet soda, which has lost market share to rival Coca-Cola ( KO ) .
Meanwhile, the Apple ( AAPL ) iPhone rumors have begun ahead of expected fall showcases .
